title: fleetd MCP tools/call rejects the MCP-standard _meta field, breaking all blackbox-fleet tools from Claude Code
wanted_capability: fleetd's MCP adapter should accept (and ignore) the optional _meta member on tools/call params, like the rmcp-based corpus (7264) and blackops (7266) servers do. Claude Code attaches _meta (progress token) to every tools/call, so every blackbox-fleet tool invocation fails with 'invalid tools/call parameters: unknown field _meta, expected name or arguments' even though auth and initialize succeed. Deserialization of CallToolRequestParams must tolerate unknown/optional spec members instead of deny-unknown-fields.
missing_primitive: spec-tolerant CallToolRequestParams deserialization in fleetd's hand-rolled MCP adapter
fallback_used: Called bro_dashboard via a raw curl streamable-HTTP shim that omits _meta (worked, stateless: no mcp-session-id issued)
evidence: mcp__blackbox-fleet__bro_dashboard error: invalid tools/call parameters: unknown field `_meta`, expected `name` or `arguments` (2026-07-15, Claude Code 2.1.211)
blackops_workflow_list on 7266 succeeds with identical client, so only fleetd's adapter is strict
resolution_note: fleetd ToolCall now accepts the MCP-reserved _meta member (crates/fleetd/src/mcp.rs) while retaining deny_unknown_fields typo protection; unit tests cover both accept-_meta and reject-unknown. Verified live post-redeploy: tools/call bro_dashboard with _meta progressToken returns data on 127.0.0.1:7265.
